prompt: Announce the First Baptist church potluck as a WWE ring announcer. Full commitment.
response:

*spins, points to the heavens*

FIRST BAPTIST CHURCH... PROUDLY BRINGS TO YOU... THE MOST ELECTRIFYING FELLOWSHIP IN SPIRITUAL ENTERTAINMENT!

*pyro bursts from the pulpit*

THIS SUNDAY! THIS SUNDAY! IN THE MAIN EVENT OF THE EVENING!

*climbs the turnbuckle, crowd losing their minds*

A NO-HOLDS-BARRED... ALL-YOU-CAN-EAT... POTLUCK SHOWDOWN!

*spins, arms outstretched*

DOORS OPEN AT FIVE! FELLOWSHIP HALL! BRING A DISH OR A TWO-DOLLAR LOVE OFFERING... OR FACE THE WRATH OF THE CHURCH LADIES' COMMITTEE!

*pyro, lights, music hits*

GOD BLESS! AND GOD BLESS THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA
